messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: bin/print available on master
parts:
I just checked in a working bin/print that works like print in RStan.

It gets built when bin/stanc is built.

To use:
bin/print <file 1> ... <file n>

It doesn't take wildcards yet. It's missing a couple of things like the model name, but it's functional. If anyone finds any problems with it or can think of ways to make it better, please let me know.


Daniel
